verdict.rationale: Steel documents a concrete integration with the Claude Agent SDK exposing its browser as in-process MCP tools (steel-docs-9), showing at least one first-party framework adapter exists. However, the evidence pack contains no documented adapters or integration guides for Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, or CrewAI, so the broader multi-framework claim is only partially substantiated. missing for 10: documented adapters for Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, and CrewAI, plus independent corroboration of any of these integrations working in practice.
